name: テクスチャ整合性
description: 測定します texture detail variation にわたる image regions. Real photos have naturally varying textures, while AI tends to produce unnaturally consistent テクスチャパターン.
mechanism: Computes GLCM texture 特徴 にわたる multiple orientations and distances. AI images produce more uniform texture statistics, while real photos show natural spatial variation.
parameters: Distances: [1, 2, 4], Angles: [0, 45, 90, 135 degrees], Features: コントラスト, 相関, energy, homogeneity
accuracy: 中 - 70-80% for detecting texture uniformity 異常
source: Haralick et al. (1973), adapted by Qian et al. (2020)
useCase: Identifying AI-typical uniform テクスチャパターン

references.title: Ojala, T. et al. (2002). Multiresolution Gray-Scale and Rotation Invariant Texture Classification. IEEE TPAMI.
Liu, Z. et al. (2020). Global Texture Enhancement for Fake Face Detection in the Wild. CVPR.

strengths:
• Multi-directional テクスチャ分析 through GLCM
• Captures spatial relationships 間の pixels
• Effective for detecting uniform AI textures
• Well-established in image 分析 literature
limitations:
• Uniform real surfaces (walls, sky) create 誤検出
• Sensitive to image 解像度 changes
• Computation increases with number of distance/angle pairs
• Post-processing can normalize texture 特徴
